# fjordrun_meta (Data Source)

Platform information: version and which features are on. Needs no token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fjordrun_meta" "platform" {}

output "version" {
  value = data.fjordrun_meta.platform.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `github_login` (Boolean) Whether GitHub login is on.
- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
- `sftp` (Boolean) Whether SFTP servers are on.
- `signup_mode` (String) How signups work.
- `sleep_when_idle` (Boolean) Whether sleep when idle is on.
- `ssh` (Boolean) Whether SSH servers are on.
- `tcp_proxy` (Boolean) Whether public TCP is on.
- `version` (String) API version.
